product.summary: Harbor helps customers, partners, and operations respond to shipment status.
product.purpose: Make shipment exceptions understandable and actionable without hiding operational risk.
product.need: Understand an exception and take a useful recovery action without waiting for support.
product.currentAlternative: Contact support for interpretation and next steps.
product.outcome: Customers recover more independently while partners receive stable status and operations sees risk earlier.

evidence.finding: The repository contains portal, API, client-library, and risk-data components.
Customer recovery is highest; partner status and operational risk are separable outcomes with dependencies.

remainsTrue: Harbor remains one product serving customers, partners, and operations.
shouldChange: Customers should understand and recover from exceptions without waiting for support.
uncertain: The exact first recovery action and risk-signal threshold.
nonGoals: Committing a Milestone or release during Product Start
constraints: Partner work follows stable core status meaning.
Risk work must not delay basic customer visibility.
successSignals: More customers resolve exceptions without support.
Partners adapt status with less rework.
assumptions: Consistent shipment events can support all three outcomes.
unknowns: Which recovery action should be delivered first.

roadmap.summary: Prioritize customer recovery while enabling partner status and operational risk outcomes.
roadmap.lifecycleExplanation: Required Product decisions are ready for review; no Milestone is committed.
roadmap.productNotes: Candidates follow outcomes rather than repository components.

candidates.title: Customer recovery
candidates.outcome: Customers understand shipment exceptions and take a useful next step.
candidates.rationale: This is the clearest current customer need.

candidates.title: Partner status
candidates.outcome: Partners consume stable shipment status with less adaptation work.
candidates.rationale: Partner integration can advance after status meaning stabilizes.

candidates.title: Operational risk
candidates.outcome: Operations sees meaningful delay risk before customers are affected.
candidates.rationale: Earlier signals matter but must not delay customer visibility.
candidates.nextAction: Clarify the first useful risk signal

multiple_audiences.note: Customers are primary; partner and operations outcomes remain separately visible.

nextActions.reason: Every required Product decision has a recorded disposition.
